sprints.summary: CMS Integration Steps 1-9 + Codex F1-F10 fixes. Steps 1-5: Adapter pattern (CMSAdapterProtocol + WordPressAdapter), factory, CMSService, ORM (93 tests). Steps 6-7: API router (11 endpoints), DI, sync runner, 9 schemas, 49 API tests. Steps 8-9: Frontend — 6 new components (CMSConnectForm, CMSConnectedState, CMSSyncedPostsTable, PublishDrawer, StaleContentActions, useCMS.ts with 10 hooks), 6 modified pages (IntegrationsTab, KanbanBoard, content/page, home/page, types.ts, endpoints.ts). Codex-reviewed twice (GPT-5.3-Codex). F1: publish persists to content_pieces. F2: type safety (removed unsafe casts). F3: inFlightRef race guards. F4: SWR prefix invalidation. F5: credential failure toast. F6: sync retrigger guard. F7: URL crash fix. F8: warning field for partial failures. F9: isSafeUrl XSS prevention. F10: drawer a11y. 62 backend + 82 frontend tests. Zero regressions.
Async pipeline conversion (12 tasks), Playwright CF bypass, content engine v1.0
Structural Signal Overhaul — S4 dual-soup, ~45 signals, GapContentBrief, 3-tier output
FastAPI REST API, SSE events, HITL fix, Codex review fixes, approval flow
Auth foundation, gap/content/brand data endpoints, research tests (109), product pipeline (5 phases), review fixes
Default-deny ASGI middleware, RBAC, tenant isolation, invite flow, stream tokens, security fixes
Settings API (team/profile/pipeline-defaults), knowledge doc upload + s1 integration
Phase 1 — 31 ORM tables, Alembic migrations, 8 repos, DI wiring
AuthServiceProtocol, JsonAuthService, DbAuthService, utility extraction, DI switch
3 service protocols, 6 implementations (Json+Db), 2 new repos, backfill script
TaskStoreProtocol, DbTaskStore write-through, ApiTaskModel ORM, startup recovery
Pipeline DB write hooks (persist_s1-s8, content persistence), backfill spec fields
Pipeline 0 — 6-step deterministic audit, 8 dimensions, penalty scoring, async crawler, 636 tests
v1.3 pipeline (6 stages, LiteLLM, E-E-A-T, 3 HITL, linker agent, 10-phase refactor), LangSmith migration
KB phases 1-5: 17 models, KBStorage, 6 agents, DAG orchestrator, 3 HITL, API router, staleness tracking, delta synthesis. 260 KB tests
AP phases A-C: 9 Pydantic models, PersonaStorage, 2 agents (suggester + generator), 2 HITL graphs, prompts. 187 AP tests
Research Orchestrator — KB→AP→VSG sequential DAG. 7 phases + Codex audit (8 findings, 5 fixed). 67 tests (50 core + 17 API). Skip logic, HITL pass-through, auto-approve, error propagation.

TD→GA→CE integration — 8-phase plan. Topic-scoped GA (cluster mapping, S2 topic queries, cross-topic dedup), CE TOPIC_DISCOVERY mode, orchestrator, DB persistence (migration 0011), API layer (2 endpoints, task runner). ~44 new tests.

Daily Tracker DB persistence — 6-phase plan. Persistence layer (5 functions), task runner, router refactor (async + DB queries), PG ENUM migration 0014, DB integration tests. Codex-reviewed (7 findings addressed). 392 DT tests, 8 skipped.

ChromaDB→pgvector migration — 8-phase plan. VectorStoreClient (469 lines), 2 Alembic migrations (0016+0017), EmbeddingRepository extensions, consumer migration (GA+AP+CPS), full ChromaDB removal, data migration script. Codex-reviewed (11 findings addressed). 429 GA tests passing.

Structured Logging Foundation (Layer 1) — structlog with stdlib bridge. Central config (core/shared_tools/structured_logging.py), 3 Settings fields, middleware rewrite (correlation IDs, context propagation), 14 runner functions, 5 scripts, 2 print eliminations. Codex-reviewed (6 findings incorporated). 22 new tests.

Structured Logging Layer 2 — Correlation & Context Propagation. 8 phases: get_context_value+scoped_bind, X-Request-ID+middleware hardening, LangSmith trace linkage, SSE context binding (PB-83), auth failure logging (PB-84), per-step/per-agent binding (PB-85), run_id binding in runners, async context propagation tests. Codex-reviewed. 48 new tests. 3 backlog items resolved.

R2 Blob Storage Phase 0 — Infrastructure Layer. R2StorageBackend (S3-compatible, 8 methods), binary read/write on ABC + Local, factory switching (STORAGE_BACKEND=local|r2), path traversal protection, paginated list_dir, exists() dir-prefix fallback, per-field config validation, lazy boto3 import. Codex-reviewed (GPT-5.3-Codex: 9 findings, 5 fixed). 84 new tests. Zero regressions on 790 existing research tests.

R2 Blob Storage Phases 1-6. Phase 1: Gap Analysis retrofit — all 49 bypasses replaced with StorageBackend (pipeline.py, s1-s8 steps, gap_data_service, gap_context_helper, gap_analysis router). Phase 2: Content Engine v1.3 — pipeline_v13 _load_artifact_text/_load_artifact_json accept StorageBackend, content_data_service mtime→TTL caching. Phase 3: Site Audit → DB-primary (not R2). Phase 4: AP/VSG cross-pipeline — runner resolve_artifacts, brand_data_service, companies/KB/AP routers, knowledge_doc_service all use StorageBackend. Phase 5: All mtime-based caches replaced with TTL-based (gap=5min, content=60-120s, audit=10min, brand=5min). Phase 6: knowledge_doc_service upload via write_bytes, s1 knowledge doc loading via read_bytes + extract_text_from_bytes. ~92 bypasses eliminated across 55 files, ~715 net lines added. 5 new test files, 18 existing test files updated.

completed.task: CMS Codex Review Fixes F1-F10. F1: publish_brief/refresh_post persist published_url/published_at on ContentPieceModel via content_repo.update(). F2: toBrief() maps published_url/published_at, removed 3 unsafe 'as unknown as' casts in KanbanBoard. F3: inFlightRef guard on all 5 CMS mutation hooks (race-condition prevention). F4: mutatePrefix() helper for SWR key-prefix matching on parameterized cache keys. F5: handleConnect surfaces connected:false error via toast. F6: isSyncActive prop disables sync while SSE stream active. F7: safePathname() try/catch prevents new URL() crash. F8: warning field in queue_stale_for_refresh response + conditional toast. F9: isSafeUrl() helper in utils.ts guards all 4 external href locations. F10: PublishDrawer a11y — role=dialog, aria-modal, Escape handler, auto-focus, type=button.

CMS Integration Steps 8-9 — Frontend. Step 8 (Settings): CMSConnectForm (credential form), CMSConnectedState (info + sync progress + disconnect), CMSSyncedPostsTable (read-only table), IntegrationsTab rewrite (real CMS flow replacing static mock). Connect→auto-sync chain. Role gating (viewers read-only). Step 9 (Publish + Stale): PublishDrawer (slide-over with slug editor, status toggle, category multi-select), KanbanBoard integration (publish icon on approved cards, published badge), StaleContentActions (stale content cards on Home Dashboard with Refresh Content → triage). Backend additions: published_url/published_at on ContentBriefListItem, brief stub creation in queue_stale_for_refresh. Foundation: 13 CMS TypeScript types, 11 API endpoints, 10 SWR hooks (5 read + 5 mutation).

CMS Integration Steps 6-7 — API router + DI wiring + tests. Step 6: api/schemas/cms.py (9 Pydantic models), api/routers/cms.py (11 endpoints: connect, get_connection, disconnect, sync, synced-posts, stale-actions, stale-to-triage, publish, refresh, publish-history, categories), api/dependencies.py (get_cms_service async generator, DB-required, no JSON fallback), api/tasks/runner.py (run_cms_sync_task with own DB session), api/tasks/models.py (+cms_sync to PipelineTask Literal), api/app.py (mount cms.router). Step 7: tests/api/test_cms.py (49 tests across 11 test classes). Codex F2 fix: tenant isolation in queue_stale_for_refresh. Codex F4 fix: added GET /categories endpoint. Codex F8 fix: reconnect uses UPDATE instead of deactivate+insert (preserves FK refs). Also added 3 CMSService methods: list_synced_posts, list_publish_history, list_categories.
key_architectural_decisions: CMSService DI: standalone orchestrator, NOT Protocol→Json→Db — requires DB (503 if no DATABASE_URL/CMS_FERNET_KEY)
Background sync: run_cms_sync_task creates own session (DI session closed after router 202 response)
Codex F2: queue_stale_for_refresh verifies post.company_slug == company_slug (tenant isolation)
Codex F4: GET /categories endpoint for publish UI category selector
Codex F8: connect() UPDATEs existing row in-place instead of deactivate+insert (preserves FK references)
All IDs are str (UUID) in schemas (D2: UUIDPKMixin), site_url is str (D9: HttpUrl breaks concat)

completed.task: R2 Blob Storage Phases 1-6 — Full pipeline retrofit + service layer migration + cache overhaul. Phase 1 (Gap Analysis, ~49 bypasses): _artifact_dir→_ga_prefix, all step files (s1-s8) accept StorageBackend+prefix, pipeline.py orchestrator uses storage for all skip-resume reads/writes, Plotly fig.write_html→fig.to_html()+storage.write(), gap_data_service/gap_context_helper/gap_analysis router all migrated. Phase 2 (Content Engine, ~8 bypasses): pipeline_v13 _load_artifact_text/_load_artifact_json accept optional StorageBackend (storage-first, filesystem-fallback for absolute paths), content_data_service overhauled (TTL caching, StorageBackend reads). Phase 3 (Site Audit): changed plan to DB-primary — structured data better served by PostgreSQL. site_audit_repo.exists_for_slug_and_domain() added, db_site_audit_data.audit_exists_for_slug() added. Phase 4 (Cross-pipeline, ~15 bypasses): runner.py resolve_artifacts accepts optional backend, brand_data_service _detect_artifact/_detect_personas use StorageBackend, companies/KB/AP/knowledge_docs routers use app.state.storage_backend, knowledge_doc_service upload/download via StorageBackend. Phase 5 (Cache invalidation): all mtime-based caches replaced with TTL-based (time.monotonic), TTLs: gap=5min, content=60-120s, audit=10min, brand=5min, gap_context=5min. Phase 6 (Binary upload+loader): knowledge_doc_service writes via storage.write_bytes(), s1_embed_assets reads knowledge docs via storage.read_bytes()+extract_text_from_bytes(), AP agents._load_knowledge_docs same pattern. New shared tool: extract_text_from_bytes() in text_extraction.py.
key_architectural_decisions: TTL-based caching replaces mtime-based everywhere (R2 has no local st_mtime_ns)
pipeline_state.json stays on local filesystem (earmarked for Redis, NOT R2)
Non-local backends must NOT fall back to filesystem reads (H3 fix in s2 _read_text)
Blocking I/O moved off event loop via asyncio.to_thread (H6 fix)
GapAnalysisInput.knowledge_doc_slug backfills from deprecated knowledge_doc_dir (backward compat)
Site audit stays DB-primary — structured data, runs daily, PostgreSQL better fit than blob storage
knowledge_doc download: FileResponse→Response with storage.read_bytes() (no filesystem path needed)
_LOCAL_BACKEND_CACHE in gap_context_helper (max 20) avoids per-call LocalStorageBackend instantiation
R2StorageBackend gains retry config (max_attempts=5) and error logging on write
